Monster Mirror

Try on monster eyes, hats, fangs, face paint and whole costumes. Just say what you want, or point at it.

Step backStand about two big steps away, so the mirror sees you from head to toe.
Say it“Witch hat!” “Googly eyes!” “Vampire fangs!” “Surprise me!” “Cheese!”
Or pointRaise a hand and hold the sparkle on a bubble until the ring fills up.
The camera picture stays on this computer. Spoken words go through Chrome’s speech service; turn voice off in settings to keep everything on the laptop.
Grown-ups: press S for settings, P for a photo, space to pause.

Settings
